exact_prompt:
Edit the attached complete original-source texture into a faithful higher-resolution game diffuse frame.
Reference is a source-only opaqueRGB NEAREST16x enlargement of the original native32x32 full square UV canvas.
Return the entire same square canvas filling the output at the same normalized UV positions, no cropping, padding, zoom, rotation, recentering or scene redesign.
Preserve every source occupied region and all original black empty margins/gaps.
This original glass diffuse frame is one irregular connected muted neutral-gray painted fragment with a thin upper-left angled arm, dim curved/angular left rim, an original dark central angular region and brighter painted lower-right regions.
Preserve those exact painted regions, their shapes, current softness and relative darkness.
Do not create physical thickness, rim reflections, faceted prisms, cracks, shiny edges or a new white tip.
Match the exact plain hand-painted original material and original pattern scale.
Add only very restrained finer soft paint detail inside the existing material, not new geometry or high-contrast texture.
Retain original soft diffuse shading and the same relative brightness throughout the source regions.
Never turn a faint source patch into a bright white knot, hard rim, curl or ray.
No new objects, pieces, lobes, disconnected marks, dots, glints, specks, highlights, tears, folds, cracks, lettering, symbols or logos.
No decorative texture network or photographic/3D realism.
Keep the exact original source colors and dark areas, no saturation or contrast enhancement.
Black source background remains black; output opaqueRGB, original native source alpha is restored separately.
Uniform brightness is corrected numerically later, not by adding stronger local highlights.

source_transform_recipe.operations: native stored RGBA to opaqueRGB only; wholecanvas NEAREST integer source-only scale to at least512px width, preserve original aspect; no crop/padding/rotation/UV fitting/BBox/composite/unpremultiplication/art insertion. Original sourceA restored separately by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to exact original4x, sourceA LANCZOS4x separately; private scalar brightness/native premultiply matches Type.

prompt_serialization: Exact built-in prompt argument preserves CRLF and equals UTF-8 prompt file bytes without trailing newline.
reference_argument_serialization: Actual reference tool arguments used absolute repository paths. Portable metadata names exact reference PNG identities with unchanged byte SHA256.
